# Advanced Graph and Algebraic Patterns

Each page contains **one mathematical formula worth memorising**, the meaning of each symbol, a substituted example, a correctness derivation, and conditions under which the formula or technique fails.

1. [Relax the best-known path upper bound](01-shortest-path-relaxation.qmd)
2. [Topological order respects dependency edges](02-dag-topological-order.qmd)
3. [Jump K by its powers of two](03-binary-lifting-powers.qmd)
4. [Every item pushed and popped at most once](04-monotonic-stack-amortisation.qmd)
5. [Kadane = start fresh or extend](05-kadane-local-versus-global.qmd)
6. [Hash strings algebraically; beware collisions](06-rolling-hash-polynomial.qmd)

Use these as **recall cards**, not as a bag of disconnected algorithms. Practise rebuilding the reasoning from the smallest example. Related full lessons live in the [Algorithms section](../../../../algorithms/index.qmd).
